mentions.name: Miniature Bluetooth Locating Tag
mentions.description: A Bluetooth-based miniature locating tag that can be glued or stuck onto any object, sized roughly one-tenth of an AirTag, works with Android, and is much cheaper. Built by an electronics/hardware engineer who is seeking app development expertise (possibly with an AI assistant) and plans a blog series documenting progress.
mentions.problem: Elderly parents kept forgetting where they last left their spectacles.
mentions.audience: A person's elderly parents who keep misplacing items such as spectacles
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on a Bluetooth based miniature range Locating tag that can be glued or stuck on to any object of choice. (think sometohing like an Airtag, but 1/10th the size and working on Android and way cheaper)
